data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental in May 2037? You’ve picked the sweet spot of the Costa del Sol calendar. Sea temperatures hit 22°C, the sun shines for 9 hours a day, and the Levante wind stays gentle at 5-10 knots. Whether you’re after a two-hour blast on a speedboat or a full-day luxury charter on a Mangusta 80, May delivers consistently good conditions. Below, we break down the weather averages, the best boats from our Puerto Banús fleet, and insider tips to make your 2037 charter unforgettable.

May 2037 Weather Averages for Marbella

Here’s what you can expect on the water:

  • Air temperature: 24°C high / 16°C low – warm but not scorching.
  • Sea temperature: 22°C average, rising to 24°C by late May.
  • Sunshine: 9 hours of direct sun; 12 hours of daylight (07:15–21:15).
  • Rainfall: Only 2-3 rainy days expected; 90% of days will be dry.
  • Wind: Prevailing easterly (Levante) at 5-10 knots; mornings are calmest.
  • UV index: High (7-8) – bring SPF 50+ and a hat.

These conditions make May ideal for swimming, snorkelling, jet-skiing, and cruising. The sea is calm enough for all boat types in our fleet, from the Marbella boat rental hub to the high-performance Mangusta 80.

Which Boat to Choose for Your May Charter

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús. For May, we recommend:

  • Small groups (5-6 pax): Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) – perfect for a quick sunset cruise or a morning swim at Cabopino.
  • Medium groups (8-10 pax): Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – Tier A pricing: €749/2h or €2,299/8h, all inclusive.
  • Large groups (12 pax): Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – Tier B from €4,719/4h with a free jet ski included.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

Best May Itineraries from Puerto Banús

With 9 hours of sun, you have time for a full-day exploration. Popular routes:

  • East to Cabopino (20 min): Sandy beach, chiringuito lunch, calm swimming.
  • West to Cala del Faro (30 min): Cliffside cove, crystal water, snorkelling.
  • West to Estepona (45 min): Marina, old town, and the famous ‘Costa del Sol’ beach.
  • West to Sotogrande (1 hour): Luxury marina, golf views, and upscale dining.

Your skipper will tailor the route based on wind and your preferences. For a shorter trip, a 2-hour sunset cruise along the Golden Mile is unbeatable.

Pricing and Booking Tips for May 2037

May is a peak shoulder season, especially around Labour Day (1 May) and weekends. Prices are lower than July-August but availability shrinks quickly. Our pricing is transparent:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80, white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours (jet ski included).
  • Other boats (Ferretti 94, K80, Canados 86, etc.): Pricing on request via WhatsApp – contact us for a custom quote.

Book at least 2-3 weeks in advance for standard boats, 4-6 weeks for the larger yachts. To secure your date, reach out via our Marbella boat rental page.

What’s Included in Every Charter

No surprises. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (nuts, crisps, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You just bring swimwear, sunscreen, and a camera. We handle the rest.
